#| label: setup

# =============================================================================
# CELL: Set-up
# The report reads the results written by the analysis notebooks (render them first, see README.md):
#   monthly_cf  monthly contract factors (data/processed/HistoricContractFactors.csv, IDA_ContractFactors.qmd)
#   forecasts   FY27-29 forecast of each model (data/forecast/FY27-29_<Model>.csv, CF_Forecast_FY27-29.qmd)
# The configuration and the plot style are the ones of the notebooks (functions/config.py, functions/utilsPlot.py).
# =============================================================================

import glob, os, sys, warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Find the project root (the folder that contains 'functions/')
ROOT = next(p for p in [os.getcwd(), os.path.dirname(os.getcwd())]
            if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(p, 'functions')))
sys.path.append(os.path.join(ROOT, 'functions'))

from config import FORECAST_DIR, make_cfg
from utilsPlot import set_style, add_titles, table_title
from utilsData import add_calendar_features

cfg = make_cfg()
set_style(small_fonts=True)

monthly_cf = add_calendar_features(pd.read_csv(cfg['cf_csv'], index_col=0, parse_dates=True))
forecasts = {os.path.basename(p)[len('FY27-29_'):-len('.csv')]: pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=['Time-ending'])
             for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(FORECAST_DIR, 'FY27-29_*.csv')))}
